input.title: Diwali
input.story:
[अंतरा 1]

दीवाली आई, दीवाली आई,
खुशियों की बहार लाई,
धुम धड़ाक, धुम-धुम धड़ाक,
चक्री, बम, हवाई।।

[अंतरा 2]

दीवाली आई, दीवाली आई,
घर-घर दीप जलेंगे,
खूब मिठाई खायेंगे,
दीवाली आई, दीवाली आई।।
input.instructions:
Create a beautiful high-quality 3D animated preschool cartoon scene for a joyful Indian Diwali children's nursery rhyme.

CHARACTERS:
Three adorable Indian children, approximately 4–6 years old, two girls and one boy, with cute expressive faces, big sparkling eyes, soft rounded facial features and joyful smiles. The girls wear colorful traditional lehenga choli outfits and the boy wears a bright yellow kurta pajama. Keep their character appearance, hairstyles, clothing and facial features consistent.

ENVIRONMENT:
A magnificent traditional Indian family home decorated for Diwali. Colorful glowing diyas along the entrance, beautiful flower garlands, vibrant rangoli patterns, decorative lanterns, warm golden lights, festive decorations and a beautiful night sky.

ACTION:
The children happily celebrate Diwali together, smiling, dancing and clapping their hands. One child holds a decorative LED lantern, another points towards the glowing diyas, while the third performs a joyful dance.

VISUAL STYLE:
Premium 3D preschool animation, adorable cartoon characters, vibrant saturated colors, cinematic lighting, soft shadows, detailed textures, beautiful festive atmosphere, expressive facial animation, polished family-friendly animated movie quality.

CAMERA:
Wide cinematic composition, eye-level camera, children in the foreground, beautifully decorated house in the background, balanced framing.

FORMAT:
16:9 widescreen, 4K quality, detailed 3D rendering, visually appealing for a children's YouTube music video.
